import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p=params
    return p[0]*np.sin(p[1]*t)*np.sqrt(v) + p[2]*np.exp(-v) + p[3]*t*np.exp(-v) + p[4]*x*np.exp(-v) + p[5]*x*v + p[6]*x + p[7]
